title: Shopping for Veggies
content: Well, this time I didn't actually set up my easel in the supermarket,like I did last time.The aisles are too narrow and it's just too busy.So I worked from photos while I painted my wife Jeanette. This one is in casein, and I captured the process in thisYouTube video.----More resourcesGurney tutorials on GumroadCasein Painting in the WildGouache Materials List
